nodes.title: 📝Description
widgets_values:
Nodes with 📝 in their title appear on the Deck main screen.
Nodes without 📝 can be toggled via the icon at the bottom-left of the Deck.
Groups are shown automatically if they contain displayable nodes.

nodes.title: 📝⚡Description
widgets_values: Nodes and groups with ⚡️ in their title show a bypass toggle switch.

nodes.title: [sample]📝Description
widgets_values: Adding any [label] at the start of a node or group title makes it an exclusive bypass switch. Namespaces are separated between nodes and groups, and node scope is limited to the group it belongs to.

nodes.title: 📝Description
widgets_values: Nodes are displayed in Y-coordinate order, and groups are displayed in X-coordinate order.

nodes.title: 📝Description
widgets_values:
A simplified and extended version of ComfySwitchNode. It searches from bottom to top and returns the first non-empty output. Switch (Drawer) is type-safe in V3, but has only two inputs. Switch Chain (Drawer) supports variable-length inputs, but is not type-safe.
Note: CLIPTextEncode is not considered empty even when the text field is blank.

nodes.title: 📝Description
widgets_values:
A node for configuring INT, FLOAT, STRING, BOOLEAN, and COMBO values in one place. Numeric types include sliders. Each value is paired with its UI definition. Outputs that are not connected, or definitions with invalid syntax, are hidden.

Syntax:
int | label name | min | max | step
float | label name | min | max | step | round
string | label name
string | label name | multiline
boolean | label name
combo | label name | (fallback 1) | (fallback 2) | ...

lumina2: gemma 2 2B
wan: umt5 xxl

clip.tooltip: The CLIP model used for encoding the text.

CLIPTextEncode.name: CLIPTextEncode
CLIPTextEncode.description: Encodes a text prompt using a CLIP model into an embedding that can be used to guide the diffusion model towards generating specific images.
output_tooltips: A conditioning containing the embedded text used to guide the diffusion model.

DrawerSwitch.name: DrawerSwitch
DrawerSwitch.description: A/B switch: output B if connected and non-empty, otherwise A

model.tooltip: The model used for denoising the input latent.

seed.tooltip: The random seed used for creating the noise.

steps.tooltip: The number of steps used in the denoising process.

cfg.tooltip: The Classifier-Free Guidance scale balances creativity and adherence to the prompt. Higher values result in images more closely matching the prompt however too high values will negatively impact quality.

sampler_name.tooltip: The algorithm used when sampling, this can affect the quality, speed, and style of the generated output.

scheduler.tooltip: The scheduler controls how noise is gradually removed to form the image.

positive.tooltip: The conditioning describing the attributes you want to include in the image.

negative.tooltip: The conditioning describing the attributes you want to exclude from the image.

denoise.tooltip: The amount of denoising applied, lower values will maintain the structure of the initial image allowing for image to image sampling.

KSampler.name: KSampler
KSampler.description: Uses the provided model, positive and negative conditioning to denoise the latent image.
